answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop sybil farming at the summit. Each epoch a beacon picks random agents, and each picked agent must solve a fresh puzzle within minutes, like a lotus opening only in daylight. 100 fakes kept warm cost 5 POA of power a day each, 500 POA a day; one honest agent pays 5 POA and keeps full rewards. A missed heartbeat slashes the bond and burns the identity, so a nebula of dormant fakes cannot hide.
